notes.title: Where have I been?
notes.content: [p]Hello everyone! I bet you guys have [strike]probably not[/strike] been wondering where I've been.[/p][p][/p][p]I know there has been a lack of updates, and I'm sorry about that! We've been working on something a lot better that I will hopefully be able to announce soon. I guess we'll see how that goes.[/p][p]Again, sorry for no updates, hopefully there will be one out soon![/p][p]See you next time![/p][p]imcool123[/p]

notes.title: HAPPY BIRTHDAY, STICKY CLICKER!
notes.content:
Sticky Clicker is 1 year old!!
It's hard to believe that just a year ago on April 19th I uploaded Sticky Clicker to Steam. Thank you everyone immensely for the support! More things will come to Sticky Clicker in the future...

Now, for the update!

Additions:
[list]
[*]Added 2 new upgrades
[*]Gave Sticky a party hat
[*]Added 2 new achievements
[/list]

Fixes:
[list]
[*]Fixed a bug where not all skins were shown
[/list]

That's all! Thanks again everyone for 1 year of clicking stickies! Here's to another!

imcool123

notes.title: Sticky Clicker Soundtrack Releasing August 1st!
notes.content:
Hey all! It's been a while since the last update...
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44964013/05c964d287fb0cad53717452232b2a0aacb7253a.png[/img]
We've been hard at work at update 1.2, so I thought I would release something to keep you guys satiated.
Introducing...
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44964013/a8efce82f75ca97f00ecd4d65c4f198e10e674b1.png[/img]
The Sticky Clicker Soundtrack!!!
The soundtrack will include 3 songs, and it will be completely free!
It includes Muisging composed by Kevin(real) and 2 songs that will be released in an earlier update, composed by imcool123.

The soundtrack will hopefully release on August 1st. If it gets delayed, I will make an announcement informing you guys when the estimated release date would be.

In the meantime, have fun clicking stickies!

imcool123

notes.title: Update 1.1
notes.content:
1.1 is here! Here's the changelog:

[list]
[*]Added saving
[*]Added 2 new buttons (Particle Accelerator, Carpal Tunnel Cream (thats an original idea by the way))
[*]Added a points per click/second counter
[*]Added a visual counter for how much of a building you own
[/list]
And that's it! Enjoy clicking Sticky!

notes.title: Update 1.1 Information!
notes.content:
Hey guys! I really haven't announced or did anything since the release, sorry ._.
Anyways, 1.1 is mostly finished, we just have to draw art and do all that stuff. The coding is finished though.
[i](hint: a very big feature is releasing...)[/i]
Yeah, that's mostly it. Expect it to definitely come this month. Ok bye!

notes.title: Sticky Clicker Release Date!
notes.content:
Sticky Clicker's release date is here!
Absolutely everyone was waiting for it!!!
April 19th is the confirmed release date of Sticky Clicker!
This has been a huge step up, from itch.io. I'm really happy with how the game turned out, and the steam release too.
Anyways, thanks for reading this if you did, and remember to click some sticks!
